T: Bring honour to us all. Bring dumplings.
D: A young woman disguises herself as a man to take her father's place in the army.
P: Serve breakfast when Mushu cooks Mulan her first morning meal at camp.
S: the matchmaker's visit that goes badly
Pork and chive dumplings folded and steamed 8 minutes, with a soy and black vinegar dip. Tea poured carefully.

Crisp golden spring rolls packed with pork mince, cabbage, carrot, glass noodles and ginger, served hot with a sweet chilli and lime dipping sauce. Soak 50g glass noodles and cut short. Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves, then add 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, the noodles, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil and cool. Roll 2 tbsp filling tightly in each of 20 spring roll wrappers, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Mix 100ml sweet chilli sauce with lime juice to dip.
the army training camp before sunrise
Edamame steamed 4 minutes, tossed in a hot wok with garlic, chilli flakes, a splash of soy and plenty of flaky salt.
M: the porridge with a smiling face Mushu makes for Mulan
Jasmine rice simmered 90 minutes in chicken stock with ginger until silky, topped with a fried egg and bacon in a smiling face, spring onion and soy.
the celebration in the Imperial City

Pork belly braised glossy and dark in light and dark soy, rock sugar, star anise and ginger, with steamed rice and garlicky stir-fried bok choy. Cut 1kg pork belly into 3cm cubes, blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain. Melt 60g rock sugar or brown sugar in a wok with 1 tbsp oil until amber, add the pork and toss to coat. Add 4 slices ginger, 3 spring onions, 2 star anise, 60ml light soy, 2 tbsp dark soy and 500ml water. Cover and simmer 1 hour, then uncover and reduce until glossy. Serve with steamed rice and bok choy stir-fried with garlic.
W: a sweet for the autumn festival

Golden syrup, oil and alkaline water mixed into flour and rested 2 hours, wrapped thinly around balls of lotus seed paste, pressed into moulds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, egg washed and baked 10 more.
K: Family temple iced jasmine lychee tea
the family temple where the ancestors gather

Jasmine green tea brewed strong and chilled, shaken with lychee syrup and lime over ice, with whole lychees and a few mint leaves in each glass. Steep 4 jasmine green tea bags in 1 litre water at 80C for 3 minutes, remove and chill. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Stir 120ml of the syrup and the juice of a lime into the cold tea. Pour over ice in 4 glasses with 3 lychees each and a few mint leaves.

s.note: the matchmaker's visit that goes badly
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with a chopped bunch of garlic chives and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes. Serve with soy and Chinkiang vinegar, and pour the tea carefully.

s.note: the army training camp before sunrise
s.how: Steam 500g edamame for 4 minutes. Toss in a hot wok with 2 sliced garlic cloves, chilli flakes and a splash of soy. Finish with plenty of flaky salt and serve in a big bowl.

m.note: the porridge with a smiling face Mushu makes for Mulan
m.how: Simmer 200g jasmine rice in 2L chicken stock with sliced ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often, until silky. Fry 4 eggs and 8 rashers bacon. Top each bowl with an egg and bacon smile, spring onion and soy.

w.note: a sweet for the autumn festival
w.how: Mix 100g golden syrup, 30ml oil and a little alkaline water, then 150g flour, and rest 2 hours. Wrap thin portions around 8 balls of lotus seed paste and press into moulds. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes, egg wash and bake 10 more.
